signature: SUBROUTINE DLA_LIN_BERR( N, NZ, NRHS, RES, AYB, BERR )

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of linear equations, i.e., the order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: nz
params.reference: We add (`NZ`+1)\*SLAMCH( 'Safe minimum' ) to R(i) in the numerator to guard against spuriously zero residuals. Default value is N.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrices `AYB`, `RES`, and `BERR`. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: RES
params.reference: The residual matrix, i.e., the matrix R in the relative backward error formula above.

params.name: AYB
params.reference: The denominator in the relative backward error formula above, i.e., the matrix abs(op(A\_s))\*abs(Y) + abs(B\_s). The matrices A, Y, and B are from iterative refinement (see dla\_gerfsx\_extended.f).

params.name: BERR
params.reference: The component-wise relative backward error from the formula above.
